blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines— Police operatives arrested a live-in couple suspected of peddling illegal drugs during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Bato, Toledo City, past 11 p.m. on Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026. Authorities identified the pair as alias “Romie,” 41, a resident of Sitio Latid, Toledo City, and his live-in partner, alias “Grace,” 24, who originally hails from Sitio Talisay, Barangay Bato in the same city. Based on the police watchlist, “Romie” was classified as a High-Value Individual (HVI) capable of wide-scale illegal drug operations in the area.
